name: @561-group/memetic-memory-unit
description: The Memetic Memory Unit: an in-memory MemeStore that STORES and READS Memes — nothing more. Memory holds the raw thing-with-evidence; folding/settling is the processing unit's job, and persistence to disk is a later, separate concern. Its only dependency on the processing unit is the Meme data class (a type), so it has no runtime dependency at all.
